capabilities: Chat with an AI side panel using the current note, folder, or all notes as context
Rewrite selected text inline (polish, shorten, expand, translate, proofread) with diff preview
Run one-click full-note polish, proofread, and translate skills
Generate full-note reviews, structure and tone analysis, and summaries
Connect to DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, SiliconFlow, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
extras: Desktop only (Windows/macOS/Linux; no iOS/Android). Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. API key is stored in the system keychain by default; note content is sent only to the configured LLM endpoint, with no telemetry.
intentEvidence: Compared to Copilot-style plugins, FleurPilot is designed around how Chinese users actually work
motivation: The author built it because existing Obsidian AI plugins treat Chinese as an afterthought; FleurPilot makes Chinese the first-class language from UI to AI prompts.
problem: Most Obsidian AI plugins are English-first, leaving Chinese users with translated interfaces and no preconfigured domestic model endpoints.
